meaning:
Gazathites or Gazites, of Gaza "the strong"
an inhabitant of the city of Gaza
Another name of az.zah (עַזָּה "Gaza" H5804)

renderings.kjv: And it was told the Gazites

elsewhere.note: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites…
The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying…
